description:
Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes. Musk made the comments at The New York Times' DealBook Summit on Wednesday as he tried to explain the conflict following weeks of back and forth between Zelenskyy, Musk, and the US government.

"From the beginning, I've said that Starlink is a civilian system,"
title: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink

description:
Senate commerce committee Chair Ted Cruz (R-TX) began a meeting Wednesday meant to confirm President Donald Trump's nominee to the Federal Communications Commission with a lopsided dais. To his right sat all 14 Republican members of the panel, including Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD). To his left were about a dozen empty chairs - every Democratic member of the panel was absent.

Cruz said he'd learned the night before that Democrats intended to boycott the vote, though Democrats say they'd repeatedly
title: Democrats skip a vote on adding Brendan Carr’s adviser to the FCC

description:
For a while there, it seemed like Lenovo had given up on selling handheld gaming PCs, hiking the price of its Legion Go 2 and Legion Go S even higher than other RAM-starved competitors. With just a few weeks remaining, lawmakers are trying to pass new protections for victims of online harm before the end of 2026, targeting deepfake creators and online platforms that block users from filing lawsuits.

title: Tech lawsuits defined 2026 — and lawmakers want more

title: The first Nvidia RTX Spark mini PCs launch today from Asus, Dell, and MSI

description:
Now that Apple's foldable is here, Google wants to make sure apps on Android foldables are a good experience. Starting in April 2027, Google is going to require Android developers to make sure their apps have a baseline level of support for foldables. If they don't, developers risk not being able to publish or update their apps or have reduced visibility for their apps on Google Play.

title: Google is forcing Android app developers to properly support foldables

title: 8BitDo’s new gamepad modernizes the Nintendo GameCube’s WaveBird

title: Shelly’s new smart valve shuts off your home’s water before a leak becomes a flood

description:
Everyone has that traveler in their life. That person who feels more at home on a 14-hour train ride than a quiet Sunday on the couch. They speak multiple languages, have a gut like a goat, and make friends wherever they go. Whether they're your kindred spirit or the person you live vicariously through, one thing never changes: They always need new gear.

That's what makes travelers so fun to buy for. But you don't want to get them just anything. The key is to find that clever gift even they didn't know they needed, and t
title: The Verge’s 2026 holiday gift guide for travelers

author: Cameron Faulkner
description:
For the past month, we’ve been inundated with Black Friday deals, signaling what’s to come on the biggest shopping day of the year in the US. We routinely get dozens of press releases a day, coming from brands big and small that hope that we’ll publicize these offers. Of course, the companies would prefer that we don’t do any research on these deals to see if they’re actually good, and most don’t provide any of the necessary context we’re looking for when vetting them.

title: How The Verge is picking which Black Friday deals to share

description:
Will Wright, the creator of legendary franchises like SimCity and The Sims, is working on a new game - and it's built around AI. The new title, focused on your memories, is called MyMems. Like Wright's other titles, it sounds extremely ambitious, giving players a new way to explore worlds they create on their own. "We want to take your autobiography and turn it into a toy world," he tells The Verge.

The MyMems website describes the mobile game as a "social simulation" with worlds "built from your memories and the people who shaped you." You can add "me
title: Will Wright’s next game uses AI to map your memories

description: Nvidia has stopped sending its advanced AI chips to China, despite the approval it received from the White House to do so in December last year. The announcement was made by interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress during an earnings call on Tuesday, marking a notable shift for the company that, under former CEO Jensen Huang, fought for the right to ship its powerful Hopper architecture
title: Nvidia isn’t selling any more AI chips to China

description: Suno has introduced image and video generation in its latest effort to expand beyond being an AI music platform. The new feature, called "Visuals," allows users to turn Suno songs into AI-generated video clips that automatically lipsync to lyrics, or make images via prompt descriptions that can be used as thumbnails and album artwork.

description:
More than a decade after Grand Theft Auto V was first released, its sequel is finally launching. On November 19th, GTA VI will be available on both the PS5 and Xbox Series X / S, and it’s quite possibly the most anticipated video game launch of all time.

Part of this has to do with the success of its predecessor, as GTA V
title: Grand Theft Auto VI has arrived

author: Andrew Webster
description: How do you follow a game like Grand Theft Auto V? Thirteen years ago, Rockstar's crime-fueled epic went on to redefine what an open-world game could be and became an enormous success, selling more than 230 million copies across three generations of game consoles. It sits just behind Tetris and Minecraft on the list of the best-selling games of all time, and its lucrative online mode has helped it remain popular for well over a decade.
title: Grand Theft Auto VI does something impossible — it lives up to the hype

author: Andrew Webster
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI isn't just the biggest GTA game to date; it's also the most romantic. Though the series is well known for its sordid assortment of criminal leads, GTA VI switches things up by starring a pair of thieves who also happen to fall in love after meeting while stealing a car. It's still an open-world action game full of chaos and mayhem. But many players will also be attempting to nurture the budding relationship in between heists. The sprawling game is designed to support both audiences.

title: ‘It’s a risk’: How Rockstar built the most detailed (and romantic) GTA yet
